brief: A caddy to carry my bottle of bleach and a scrub brush around the house.

requirements.evidence: 2-cell joined base (piece 0,0,0 + 1,0,0 with side-connector), second storey, grab handles accessory:1#0,0#1/#2; capped and locked. No handle prop for top carry — side grab handles only.
requirements.requirement: Caddy that can be carried around the house

requirements.evidence: One open cell bin:1# bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full provides a deep pocket; no bleach-bottle prop exists in catalog so fit not staged. Second cell closed with cover:1,0,1;full;top.
requirements.requirement: Holds a bottle of bleach upright

requirements.evidence: No scrub-brush prop in catalog (only paint brush 190mm). No second open compartment fitted; second cell is covered.
requirements.requirement: Holds a scrub brush alongside the bottle

finish.summary: Two-cell caddy base with deep bin and side grab handles, capped/locked and mesh-clear. No bleach or scrub-brush props exist to stage purpose, and second cell was covered rather than left open, so brush space and bottle fit are unproven.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
